visual_species: Leptobarbus cf. hoevenii, Sultan fish visual study

photos_inspected.license: GFDL / CC BY-SA 3.0 photo reference only; no photograph pixels embedded or redistributed
observations: elongate silver body with large dark-edged scales and olive-grey back
small terminal mouth and gold iris; no invented mouth barbels
short soft dorsal, posterior anal and forked reddish-brown caudal
warm subdued fin coloration without juvenile dark flank stripe

identification_limits: The supplied Sultan fish / Ikan jelawat is interpreted as Leptobarbus cf. hoevenii. The inspected 2009 aquarium photograph uses the older broad name; L. rubripinna is now separately valid in the CAS catalog. The artwork is not a certified identification of that photograph or an exact stock.

anatomical_reference.scope: Diagnostic anatomy and identification limits; not photo-stock certification.
